name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Generative AI and large language models
Python for data science and AI
Building AI applications with Python and Flask
Transformers such as BERT and LLMs such as GPT
Frameworks such as RAG and LangChain
reading.format: A 16 course series delivered on Coursera, with hands on labs, projects and practical evaluations, and a guided project to create a real world generative AI application. The page says it takes about 6 months and is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: The IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 16 course series from IBM offered on Coursera. It teaches generative AI, large language models and natural language processing, and includes a guided project in which learners build a real world generative AI application. Completing it shows employers practical experience with building and deploying generative AI applications, agents and chatbots.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI research engineers. It is listed as beginner level and states no prior experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: No prior experience required. The page lists it as beginner level.
